metadata.main_connection: warmed before timing; fresh empty Session caches every run
metadata.network: PG protocol-framed local TCP proxy; half RTT before first request and first response of each cycle; startup also delayed; TCP_NODELAY
metadata.independent_window_kind: Fixed independent I/O-wait model, not CPU computation
metadata.setup: Load B through Session.get before timing; leave future C/D data uncached.

aggregation: Median of 11 trials per policy; deck rounds interval ms to 3 decimal places.
execution_path: Explicit prediction adapter before automatic compiler hooks and savepoint isolation.
time_boundary: Checkpoint interval through foreground work and outstanding prefetch completion. DB-call time is elapsed PgWireConnection.run including network/server/driver response handling.
wire_bytes_boundary: Returned PostgreSQL DataRow bytes; other frames and TCP/IP headers excluded.
matrix: Median selected vs. batched interval at each of six RTT/independent-wait settings. Percent is the ratio of medians minus one.
